criteria.criterion: After every Copilot work session the driver reads the session's JSON Lines; a call that ran is a `tool.execution_start` whose `tool.execution_complete` of the same `data.toolCallId` does not carry `data.error.code` `denied`, or that has no completion.
criteria.evidence: internal/driver/fencecheck.go bypassedCalls pairs start and complete by toolCallId; TestBypassedCalls covers no completion, denied and completed.

criteria.criterion: Each call that ran is judged by `fence.New(phase, root, home)` and `Decide` — the hook's own judge — with tool, path and command read from `data.toolName` and `data.arguments` exactly as `parseHookPayload` reads `toolName` and `toolArgs` (an object, or a JSON string holding one; `path`; a skill's `skill` or `name`; apply_patch's `input`, `patch` or `command`), and with the hook's rule first: a `bash` or `powershell` call with an empty command is denied with `the <tool> call has no command the hook can read`. Violation: a second argument parser that can diverge from the hook's, or any judge or rule list other than the hook's.
criteria.evidence: internal/cli/fence.go CallJudge reuses parseHookPayload and decideCall (empty-command rule, then Decide), which the hook also calls. internal/cli/calljudge_test.go now pins string toolArgs, the empty bash and powershell command message, path and skill name, against the real CallJudge.

criteria.criterion: The driver does not import `internal/fence` (which imports `internal/driver`); the judge reaches the driver another way (for example as a function the CLI hands it). The check is the phases', not `Runner.Run`'s: `tools/agent-eval` and its tests are unchanged.
criteria.evidence: driver.CallJudge func type, set in internal/cli/run.go via Iterator.Judge. git diff main shows no change under tools/ or internal/fence.

criteria.criterion: With one or more denied, stderr has one line per denied call, `vloop: <tool> <what> — <the judge's reason>`, `<what>` the call's path, else the first line of its command cut to 200 runes with `…` added when cut, else nothing (`vloop: <tool> — <reason>`); then the run halts with exit 9 and `FENCE BYPASSED work — the session ran <n> call(s) its fence denies; nothing from it was used`. Every line is masked (`$HOME` as `~`) and written to the run log too, as `REFS MOVED`'s warnings are.
criteria.evidence: iterate.go fenceBypassed uses it.warn (masks, logs, prints), then haltGit. The forms of <what> are covered by TestBypassedCalls and the exit 9 and message by TestRunFenceBackstopBypassed.

criteria.criterion: The check runs as soon as the work session ends, whatever its exit, before the phase's own checks (so before REFS MOVED); the phase still makes its restores of the driver's inputs before exiting 9; the halt comes before the proposal is used or anything is committed, and the work tree is otherwise left as the session left it. With no call denied nothing changes and nothing is printed. A Claude session's handling is unchanged (violation: any change to how a Claude session is run, parsed or halted).
criteria.evidence: iterate.go workSession calls fenceBypassed after restoreInputs and before gitChanged and the report. session.go gates the judge on AgentCopilot. TestRunFenceBackstopAllowedCall checks that nothing is printed.

criteria.criterion: Committed tests: the worked example's first three lines as one `cmd/vloop` test each (a work session's bash `git commit -m x` completed without error -> the two stderr lines, exit 9, no new commit; the same call completed `denied` -> the iteration goes on; a bash `ls` only -> the iteration goes on), with the harness's stub `copilot` gaining, in test code, the prompts of every phase (`/vloop:<phase>` with or without an argument) and the tool events a test's copilot-script.sh asks for; and tests of the reading of fixture JSON Lines (a call with no completion, a denied completion, the path / first-line / 200-rune / nothing forms of `<what>`, the empty-command rule). `TestRunHarnessCopilot`'s refusal of `/vloop:work T1` changes only to pin a prompt the stub still refuses; no other existing test changes.
criteria.evidence: cmd/vloop/run_fencecheck_test.go has the three tests. run_harness_test.go stub accepts all phases and STUB_CALLS, and only the refused prompt changed to /vloop:bogus. fencecheck_test.go covers the fixture reading, and calljudge_test.go the empty-command rule.

criteria.criterion: No fence's rules change: `fence/*.json` and the judge's decisions are as at the base.
criteria.evidence: git diff main --stat shows nothing under internal/fence.

notes: The two-line stderr criterion is covered by the check that the first line names the call plus the FENCE BYPASSED line. The go check log passed, including the new test.
